description: This Java source file defines the main class PcbCopyTool, which performs a copy operation on PCB files, reading a source PCB file, removing nodes, and writing the result to a destination file. It functions as a utility program for PCB file manipulation.

classes.name: PcbCopyTool
classes.description: Main utility class for copying and processing PCB files.
